summary: Tested new Mood feature (backend + frontend) plus tab-bar regression. All 7 backend tests pass (auth guard on both endpoints, /api/mood/detect with real face image, /api/mood/recommend for salty/sweet/balanced in id and en). Full E2E frontend flow succeeds on mobile viewport: demo login -> tab-mood navigation -> face photo upload -> mood-result card ('Bahagia' with emoji and note) -> craving chips -> mood-get-recs -> 4 rec cards (rec-0..rec-3) with Indonesian names, kcal and reasons -> mood-again resets to take-photo. Regression: all 5 tabs (Home/Mood/Scan/History/Profile) visible and navigate correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: MoodFood.jsx sends the full data URL (data:image/jpeg;base64,...) to /api/mood/detect; works because backend accepts it, but stripping the prefix client-side would reduce payload naming ambiguity.
getRecs assumes `mood` is set; guarded by conditional render so safe, but a null-check would be defensive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mood endpoints verified with real Unsplash face image; craving chips + recommendations flow fully working in Indonesian. Existing backend suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still valid. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env for tests.
